title: Michelle in the Sunshine
style: bright country pop, female lead vocal high tones, dreamy positive, acoustic guitar, soft pedal steel, light brushed drums, warm bass, sunny uplifting, 102 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Saturday morning, court is open wide
Michelle is ready, paddle by her side
Bright yellow ball bouncing in the sun
Michelle is here, ready to have some fun

[Verse 2]
Friends on the sideline, smiles all around
Michelle is the prettiest player on the ground
Light on her feet, eyes on the line
Michelle is feeling fine, feeling fine

[Chorus]
Michelle in the sunshine, Michelle in the breeze
Michelle on the court, moving with such ease
Bright yellow ball, blue sky above
Michelle is playing the game she loves

[Verse 3]
Soft little drop, sweet little spin
Michelle is gonna find a way to win
Not too loud, not too proud
Michelle just smiles at the friendly crowd

[Chorus]
Michelle in the sunshine, Michelle in the breeze
Michelle on the court, moving with such ease
Bright yellow ball, blue sky above
Michelle is playing the game she loves

[Bridge]
Like a bee to a flower, like a song to my heart
Michelle and the ball were never meant to part
Sunny afternoon, gentle little game
Michelle on the court, never the same

[Outro]
Michelle in the sunshine…
Bright yellow, blue sky…
Michelle and the ball… oh my…
